fixes.name: deployment.rollback-to-revision
fixes.description: Roll the Deployment back to the pod template of an earlier revision, as kubectl rollout undo does. revision is that revision's number, from the rollout history.
fixes.params_schema: {"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["revision"],"properties":{"revision":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"description":"The earlier revision to roll back to."}}}

root_causes.name: memory_limit_regression
root_causes.description: the new revision's memory limit is too low

root_causes.name: bad_configuration
root_causes.description: the new revision's settings are wrong

root_causes.name: application_bug
root_causes.description: its code fails, whichever revision runs

root_causes.name: configuration_change
root_causes.description: a ConfigMap or Secret changed outside the rollout

root_causes.name: insufficient_capacity
root_causes.description: no room in the cluster for its pods

root_causes.name: node_problem
root_causes.description: a node is unhealthy or evicting pods

root_causes.name: storage_full
root_causes.description: a disk or volume is full

root_causes.name: traffic_spike
root_causes.description: more load than it can take

root_causes.name: other
root_causes.description: none of these: say what in the summary

guidance:
A rollback is right when the latest rollout brought the failures: the
revision before it ran without failing where the current one fails
(failures_came_with_rollout is true). If the failure started before the
rollout, if there is no earlier revision or it failed too, if the current
revision ran without failing at least as long as the one before it did
(failures_came_with_rollout is false), if the target is managed by
GitOps, if its config changed before the failure, or if the evidence is
missing, such as no history of the revision before it
(failures_came_with_rollout is unknown), do not propose a rollback:
conclude inconclusive and say what is missing.

When oom_killed_new_revision, failure_onset_after_rollout and
failures_came_with_rollout are all true, and gitops_managed and
config_changed_before_failure are false, rolling back to the revision
before it is justified, even if the logs are empty: a process killed for
memory often writes nothing.

Naming a cause doesn't make a rollback right: these conditions do.

container_logs_tail.data: {"pod":"checkout-7d9f8b6c4-x2kqp","container":"app","previousRun":false,"logs":"","note":"The container wrote nothing. Processes killed for using too much memory often write nothing, so the silence proves nothing either way."}

templates.name: rollout_history
templates.description: The Deployment's rollout progress, conditions, GitOps ownership markers, and each ReplicaSet revision with its images and resource limits.

templates.name: pod_states
templates.description: Each pod of the Deployment: its revision, readiness, and each container's state and last termination (where OOMKilled shows).

templates.name: target_events
templates.description: Recent events of the Deployment, its ReplicaSets and its pods, newest first.

templates.name: referenced_config
templates.description: The ConfigMaps and Secrets the pod template refers to, and when each ConfigMap last changed. Names and times only, never values.

templates.name: container_logs_tail
templates.description: The end of one container's logs. Defaults to the pod needing attention most, from the run that last ended.

templates.name: revision_health
templates.description: How the pods of the current revision and of the one before it ran, from the metrics source's history: when it first and last has them, their restarts and OOM kills, and their CPU throttling, each with when it first showed. A source without history says so.

gaps.detail: collect revision_health: no figures: no metrics source is set up

predicates.name: earlier_revision_healthy
predicates.reason: 3 pods of revision 1 are ready and never failed

predicates.name: failures_came_with_rollout
predicates.reason: 3 pods of revision 1 run without failing while revision 2 fails

predicates.name: oom_killed_new_revision
predicates.reason: none of the 1 pods of revision 2 was OOMKilled

predicates.name: config_changed_before_failure
predicates.reason: no failure with a known time

policy.reason: Refused. The rollout-regression profile allows a rollback only when the failures started after the rollout, and the checks couldn't tell (no failure observed).
